facts.value: Traversal begins at currentDirectory. A slash encountered at the start of a traversal iteration resets to root entry 0; './' preserves the traversal directory and '../' selects its parent. Empty input or terminal '.' returns that directory, and terminal '..' returns its parent. When __DVDLongFileNameFlag is zero, ordinary components are checked for spaces, repeated periods, a first period occurring after more than eight characters, and extensions longer than three characters; detected violations cause OSPanic. These checks are not complete 8.3 enforcement: a dotless component longer than eight characters is not rejected for length. The global currentDirectory is not changed by this traversal.
facts.rationale: Corrects the existing explanation's claim that the validator always limits the base to eight characters. The base-length test occurs only inside the period branch, while traversal uses a local directory index.

evidence.why: Shows special-component transitions and the exact conditional restricted-name checks.
Matched directories update only local traversal state.
